title: Chapter 119 Changes In Attributes
content:
Chapter 119 Changes In Attributes

Rebuilding the village is the most important thing at the moment.

Wang Shuo opened the [Territory Properties] panel.

[Territory attributes]

[Territory: Wana Village (first-level village)]

[Lord: Wang Shuo]

[Territory attributes: people’s aspirations, outstanding people]

[Territorial reputation: 100 (first known)]

[Area: 2 kilometers in radius]

【Population: 65】

[Popularity: 95 (average)]

[Buildings: 1. First-level village administrative center. 】

[Military: Cavalry squad, militia squad. 】

…

[Upgrade conditions: To upgrade a second-level village, you need a population of 200 people, a popular support of 80, and a second-level energy converter. 】

Seeing this introduction, Wang Shuo sighed in his heart.

Yes, the population is insufficient!

This war directly caused the loss of one-third of the population in his territory.

This made Wang Shuo heartbroken. On the one hand, he felt heartbroken for his territory, but on the other hand, these were all living people!

There were only eight people left in the militia team, and the captain, Hua Tianxiong, also died.

But the remaining people have experienced a great battle, have the attribute of command, and can lead troops.

He looked at the above introduction again and found that a second-level energy converter was needed.

He knew about the energy converter, but what the hell was this secondary one?

The function of the energy converter should be to convert the energy of the energy crystal into usable energy similar to "electrical" energy.

I don’t know if this thing is easy to use.

At this moment, he noticed that there were many important attributes-improving props in his backpack.

[Agility improvement pill: After taking it, agility will increase by 5 points. Each person is limited to 1 pill. 】

[Python Gallbladder: After taking it, all attributes will be +2. 】

[Marrow Cleansing Pill: After taking it, the player's qualification level +1. 】

Wang Shuo drooled.

Wang Shuo hesitated, should we eat together? Or eat them one by one?

Before long, a strange smile appeared on Wang Shuo's face.

"Today, I will take the luxury of it and see if taking it at the same time will have any additional effects."

So, he stuffed these several elixirs into his mouth at the same time.

If any other players saw this, they would definitely cut Wang Shuo into pieces with jealous and angry eyes.

It would be extremely difficult for others to get one, but Wang Shuo was so "arrogant" and inhumane at this time.

Treat good things that increase attributes as snacks.

After chewing hard for a few times, various flavors mixed in my mouth.

Wang Shuo regretted it a little. It tasted sweet, bitter, and felt a bit like eating puffs.

Various flavors stimulated his taste buds.

But soon, the system prompt sounded.

[Your strength +2, constitution +2, agility +7, spirit +2. 】

[Your qualifications are upgraded from D level to C level. Each time you increase your qualifications, you will gain free attributes +3. 】

Wang Shuo's eyebrows were raised with joy, and he was even more excited.

In addition to the improvement in all attributes obtained from killing the boss after taking Purple Spirit Flower before, and the improvement in attributes brought about by the upgrade of "Wandering Dragon Spear Technique".

Wang Shuo quickly opened the [Personal Attributes] panel after not checking his personal attributes for a long time.

[ID: SAC5678 Wang Shuo]

[Level: Level 24]

[Strength: 56 (26+30)]

[Physique: 41 (31+10)]

[Agility: 44 (41+3)]

[Energy: 34 (33+1)]

[Life skills: 1. Mixing mud, 2. Making mud pits]

(Qualification: C level, each level provides 3 free attribute points.)

(Allocable free attribute points: 41 (7+34) points)

[Combat attribute panel]

[Attack power: 100+56+6]

[Defense: 20]

[Commander value: 38]

[Reputation value: 1850]

[Health value: 2810]

[Experience value: 1500/240000]

[Skill Technique: "Wandering Dragon Spear Technique\
